bike.definition:
n a motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame
n a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals
v ride a bicycle
bike.translation: n. 自行车, 脚踏车

biked.translation: v. 自行车( bike的过去式和过去分词 )

biker.translation: n. 骑自行车/摩托车的人

bikers.translation: (biker 的复数) n. 骑自行车/摩托车的人

bikes.definition:
n a motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame
n a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals

bikes.translation:

bikh.definition:
n. The East Indian name of a virulent poison extracted from
   Aconitum ferox or other species of aconite: also, the plant itself.
